visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a light beige knit cardigan and a grey undershirt stands in a brightly lit indoor studio. He holds a black dry-erase marker and begins writing characters on a white board that says '大抓周學院'. A small animated cartoon graphic of a woman with black hair and a smiling expression appears on the lower-left corner. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a person's hand with dark skin pointing a finger upwards against a blurred gray background. Bold red text overlays reading '不要玩火' and '危險' appear in the center of the frame to emphasize a warning. (3) The man in the cardigan returns to the screen, now holding a small black bear plushie with a white crescent on its chest. He speaks directly to the camera with active hand gestures while holding the toy, appearing engaged and instructional. (4) A rapid cut shows a close-up focusing on two hands quickly flipping through the pages of a thick book, with the motion blur suggesting speed. (5) The man continues his presentation in the studio, gesturing towards the whiteboard which now contains drawings of a magnifying glass and the word '世界'. His facial expressions are animated and friendly. (6) A sharp close-up shows a wooden judge's gavel striking a sounding block on a dark desk, set against a background of a large office window with city light filtering through. (7) Back to the man in the studio, who continues to explain his concepts while holding the black bear plushie. He uses both hands to emphasize his points, occasionally looking down at the bear or back at the whiteboard. (8) A large graphic advertisement for a course titled '世界史的國際觀察術' overlays the screen, featuring photos of two men. The man in the cardigan points toward the graphic before the scene transitions to a solid green background featuring the '大抓周學院 BIG CATCH' logo.
